newsitem.title: FRANCE: Thomson-CSF in $79.5 mln Singapore contract.
newsitem.headline: Thomson-CSF in $79.5 mln Singapore contract.

text.p: French defence electronics group Thomson-CSF said on Tuesday its Syseca unit won in partnership with prime contractor ST Electronic & Engineering (ST E&E) a $79.5 million contract to supply a command and control system for the Singapore police, civil defence force and narcotics bureau.

The contract awarded by the Singapore Ministry of Home Affairs is to design, develop, install and commission the fully integrated and secured system that will be deployed, linking headquarters to over 40 secondary command centres.
The system will cover all daily operations. As soon as the system receives an emergency call it will inform the nearest operations centre or mobile unit.

Syseca, which already has a number of contracts in Singapore, will be working with ST E&E to develop the command and control system. Thomson Services and Industrie will supply the mobile data terminals as subcontractor to Syseca.
The police force and the civil defence force will be equipped with the new system by 1999 and the Central Narcotics Bureau (CNB) will be linked up the following year.
